hooks.command:
python3.11 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess, re, os

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '') or data.get('command', '')

if not re.search(r'\\bgit\\s+push\\b', cmd):
    sys.exit(0)

project_dir = '/Users/mohankrishnaalavala/Documents/project_handover'
errors = []

# Auto-fix what ruff can
subprocess.run(['ruff', 'format', 'handover/', 'tests/'], capture_output=True, cwd=project_dir)
subprocess.run(['ruff', 'check', '--fix', 'handover/', 'tests/'], capture_output=True, cwd=project_dir)

# Commit any auto-fixes
diff = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=project_dir)
if diff.stdout.strip():
    subprocess.run(['git', 'add', 'handover/', 'tests/'], capture_output=True, cwd=project_dir)
    fix = subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', 'chore: auto-fix lint before push'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=project_dir)
    if fix.returncode == 0:
        print('[lint-hook] Auto-committed lint fixes', file=sys.stderr)

# Verify all checks pass
r1 = subprocess.run(['ruff', 'check', 'handover/', 'tests/'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=project_dir)
if r1.returncode != 0:
    errors.append('ruff check:\n' + r1.stdout.strip())

r2 = subprocess.run(['ruff', 'format', '--check', 'handover/', 'tests/'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=project_dir)
if r2.returncode != 0:
    errors.append('ruff format --check failed: run ruff format handover/ tests/')

r3 = subprocess.run(['mypy', 'handover/'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=project_dir)
if r3.returncode != 0:
    errors.append('mypy:\n' + r3.stdout.strip())

if errors:
    msg = 'Lint/type checks failed (after auto-fix attempt).\n\n' + '\n\n'.join(errors)
    print(json.dumps({'continue': False, 'stopReason': msg}))
    sys.exit(2)

print('[lint-hook] ruff + mypy passed', file=sys.stderr)
"
